identitySignals: Name matches: Kinvolved, a K-12 attendance and family communication software company (KiNVO), matching the agenda's 'Kinvolved, Inc.'
Based in New York City (Empire State Development press release), matching the agenda's 'New York, NY'

research.notes: Not confirmed as published: no registry entry (SoS, SAM, EIN) was checked or found, no direct page linking Kinvolved to OUSD was found, and kinvolved.com now redirects to PowerSchool (acquired 2022), so website and contact details were left null rather than attributing PowerSchool's details to Kinvolved. The agreement predates the acquisition.

profile.summary: Kinvolved is a New York City education software company. Its KiNVO product helps K-12 schools track attendance and send translated text, voice and email messages to families to reduce absences. PowerSchool agreed to acquire the company in January 2022.

sources.title: Empire State Development Announces $54,000 Investment in Kinvolved
